heading: Tonight
text: Rain showers diminishing west to east overnight, with patchy river valley fog developing. Lows from the upper 50s to mid-60s north to south. Wind diminishing to calm.

heading: Tuesday
text: Partly cloudy skies in the morning, then increasing sunshine. Highs from the upper 70s north to low 80s south. Light and variable wind.

heading: Tuesday Night
text: Mostly clear, with a few passing clouds overnight. Lows from the mid to upper 50s, nearing 60 along Lake Champlain. Calm wind.
